name: SIEM / syslog
author: NetMaster
description: Sends NetMaster's alerts (new devices, attacks, open ports, outages ...) to your log server or SIEM as syslog, CEF or JSON: Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Wazuh, Graylog, Elastic, QRadar, ArcSight, rsyslog and others.

settings.label: Log server address
settings.help: The IP or name of the log server or the SIEM's collector.

settings.label: Port
settings.help: Usually 514 for UDP and TCP, 6514 for TLS.

settings.label: Check the server's certificate (TLS)
settings.help: Turn off only for a log server in your own network with a self-signed certificate.

actions.label: Send a test
actions.help: Sends a test message with the current settings. Save first.
